import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_InstalledFamily
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_InstalledTransport
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_PublicCarrierFrame
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SourceSelectionContract
open R0P R0Z R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.JointView R1Z.GamesR1
local notation "K" => PrivacyR1AcctBasis.K
variable {CommitHandle : Type}

/-- Exact installed inputs/transport consumed by source identification. The
actual selection, compiler success and RspendPlus proof remain to be installed.
No proof field below is an axiom or an inferred source theorem. -/
structure Data where
  selection : PV_RunJoin_InstalledFamily.Selection CommitHandle
  publicBinding : PV_RunJoin_InstalledFamily.PublicBinding selection

abbrev endpointHonest := PhaseWireLog2Bin.honest PV_RunJoin_SourceEndpoint.input

theorem installed_row (j : Fin 1024) : endpointHonest.transport j = PV_Src_Transport.row j :=
  PV_RunJoin_InstalledTransport.endpoint_row_call j

/-- Expose the SAME selected compilation rather than accepting another output
with a convenient public statement. Native successful-run/admission laws must
refer to this exact record. -/
def selectedRecord (d : Data (CommitHandle := CommitHandle))
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : endpointHonest.Instance) :=
  d.selection.selected endpointHonest x w

theorem selected_public (d : Data (CommitHandle := CommitHandle))
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : endpointHonest.Instance)
    (hw : endpointHonest.public w = x.1) :
    PV_Src_NativeInput.publicInput (selectedRecord d x w) =
      PV_Src_NativeInput.publicInput (d.selection.publicRecord x) :=
  d.publicBinding endpointHonest x w hw

#print Data
#print selectedRecord
#print axioms installed_row
#print axioms selected_public
end R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SourceSelectionContract

import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SourceSelectionContract
import R1Z.PV_Src_NativePremises
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SelectedAdmission
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0P R0Z.ZkStatement R0Z.WriterRefine R1J.SpendWitnessMap
open BuilderForestAdmissionPort BuilderForestAdmissionPort.pool_v1
open PV_Src_Forest_PrimitiveArguments PV_Src_NativeInput
local notation "K" => PrivacyR1AcctBasis.K
local instance : CharP K 2147483647 :=
  charP_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K).injective AspisCircleGroupOrder.P
variable [ExternalLinear] [Records]
variable {CommitHandle : Type}
variable (d : PV_RunJoin_SourceSelectionContract.Data (CommitHandle := CommitHandle))
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
local notation "selected" => fun w => PV_RunJoin_SourceSelectionContract.selectedRecord d x w
local notation "transport" => PV_RunJoin_SourceSelectionContract.endpointHonest.transport

/-- Same selected records and exact original endpoint transport. The four
remaining source fields are explicit; row_call is a theorem, not an input. -/
structure Remainder : Prop where
  compile_call : ∀ w, run (selected w) = ok (.Ok (selected w).compiled)
  words : ∀ w records, newRecords (selected w) = ok records → WitnessOk (wordWitness records.w)
  publicCorr : ∀ w records, newRecords (selected w) = ok records →
    PubCorr (wordPublic records.p)
      (mapPub («K» := K) (PV_Src_Public.canonicalPublic (publicInput (selected w))))
  admission : ∀ w records, newRecords (selected w) = ok records →
    BuilderSpendRelation.RspendPlus
      (mapPub («K» := K) (PV_Src_Public.canonicalPublic (publicInput (selected w))))
      (BuilderCanonical.liftWitness (BuilderRecordCanonical.witness (wordWitness records.w)))

def toPremises (remaining : Remainder d x) :
    PV_Src_NativeIdentification.PV_Src_Premises («K» := K) selected transport where
  compile_call := remaining.compile_call
  words := remaining.words
  publicCorr := remaining.publicCorr
  admission := remaining.admission
  row_call := PV_RunJoin_SourceSelectionContract.installed_row

#print Remainder
#print axioms toPremises
end R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SelectedAdmission

import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_CallerWorld
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_NominalPublicData
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_DictionaryIdentity
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_LedgerSourceBody
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_PureSourceLift
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_NativeSelectedInputs
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ProverRwFull ProverRwRetryModel
local instance : ProverRwRngCaller.NativeTypes := PV_RunJoin_CallerWorld.nativeTypes
local instance : ProverRwRngCaller.ErasureFns := ⟨fun _ value => .ok value,fun _ value => .ok value⟩

abbrev SourceState (base : ExternalTypes) (N C : Type) :=
  letI : ExternalTypes := PDict_CodecDictionary.native base
  PV_RunJoin_PureSourceLift.State N C
abbrev LedgerState (base : ExternalTypes) (N C : Type) :=
  letI : ExternalTypes := PDict_CodecDictionary.native base
  PV_RunJoin_LedgerBody.State N C

variable {N C : Type}

def inputs (base : ExternalTypes)
    (ops : SourceState base N C → @ExternalFuns (PDict_CodecDictionary.native base))
    (hash : Slice (Slice U8) → Result (Array U8 32#usize)) (i : PV_Src_NativeInput.Input) :
    letI : ExternalTypes := PDict_CodecDictionary.native base
    PV_RunJoin_PureSourceLift.Inputs N C := by
  letI : ExternalTypes := PDict_CodecDictionary.native base
  exact {
    ops := fun s => PDict_CodecDictionary.selected base (ops s)
    pub := fun _ => PV_RunJoin_NominalPublicData.fromInput base i
    compiled := fun _ => PV_RunJoin_NominalCompiledData.compiled base i.compiled
    hash := fun _ => hash }

def ledgerInputs (base : ExternalTypes)
    (ops : LedgerState base N C → @ExternalFuns (PDict_CodecDictionary.native base))
    (hash : Slice (Slice U8) → Result (Array U8 32#usize)) (i : PV_Src_NativeInput.Input) :
    letI : ExternalTypes := PDict_CodecDictionary.native base
    PV_RunJoin_LedgerBody.Inputs N C := by
  letI : ExternalTypes := PDict_CodecDictionary.native base
  exact {
    ops := fun s => PDict_CodecDictionary.selected base (ops s)
    pub := fun _ => PV_RunJoin_NominalPublicData.fromInput base i
    compiled := fun _ => PV_RunJoin_NominalCompiledData.compiled base i.compiled
    hash := fun _ => hash }

theorem same_selected_compilation (base : ExternalTypes)
    (ops : SourceState base N C → @ExternalFuns (PDict_CodecDictionary.native base))
    (hash : Slice (Slice U8) → Result (Array U8 32#usize)) (i : PV_Src_NativeInput.Input)
    (s : SourceState base N C) :
    letI : ExternalTypes := PDict_CodecDictionary.native base
    (inputs base ops hash i).compiled s = PV_RunJoin_NominalCompiledData.compiled base i.compiled := rfl

theorem full_ledger_source (base : ExternalTypes)
    (ops : LedgerState base N C → @ExternalFuns (PDict_CodecDictionary.native base))
    (hash : Slice (Slice U8) → Result (Array U8 32#usize)) (i : PV_Src_NativeInput.Input)
    (schedule : ProverCommitLedger36.Schedule) (unix : Bool) (address : PV_RunJoin_LedgerWorld.Address) :
    letI : ExternalTypes := PDict_CodecDictionary.native base
    PV_RunJoin_UnifiedRetry.BodySourceLaw
      (PV_RunJoin_LedgerSourceBody.sourceBody (ledgerInputs base ops hash i))
      (PV_RunJoin_LedgerBody.body schedule unix address (ledgerInputs base ops hash i)) := by
  letI : ExternalTypes := PDict_CodecDictionary.native base
  apply PV_RunJoin_LedgerSourceBody.source_law
  intro s
  exact PV_RunJoin_DictionaryIdentity.map_error base (ops s)

#print axioms same_selected_compilation
#print axioms full_ledger_source
end R1Z.PV_RunJoin_NativeSelectedInputs

import R1Z.PV_Src_Transport
import R1Z.PV_RunJoin_SourceEndpoint
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.PV_RunJoin_InstalledTransport

/-- Exact row_call at the SAME fixed honest caller used by SourceEndpoint and
privacy_headline_deployed. This identifies the installed mathematical S2 row
map with srcid's extracted arithmetic reference. It does not identify an
uninterpreted native bitwise dictionary leaf with that reference. -/
theorem endpoint_row_call (j : Fin 1024) :
    (PhaseWireLog2Bin.honest PV_RunJoin_SourceEndpoint.input).transport j =
      PV_Src_Transport.row j :=
  (PV_Src_Transport.row_eq j).symm

theorem endpoint_transport :
    (PhaseWireLog2Bin.honest PV_RunJoin_SourceEndpoint.input).transport =
      PV_Src_Transport.transport := by
  apply Equiv.ext
  exact endpoint_row_call

#print axioms endpoint_row_call
#print axioms endpoint_transport
end R1Z.PV_RunJoin_InstalledTransport
